title: feat(spec): a field can say it is not asked for when a record is created (showOnCreate)
body:

_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbCxiFE11rsKwyNffJZKYqJs)_

repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jVMKrYARogu1S6PcHj

Part of #36425 (PR 1 of 2: the field key and its save-time refusal. PR 2 retires the internal create and edit forms in the Console and Studio, adds the readers of this key, the Studio switch and the lint notice. The skills text is #36455, a domain:skills card.)

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up #36455

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：这一步用户无感。对象的字段定义可以写「新建时显示」开关（默认开）；给必填字段关掉它，保存定义时会被拒绝并说明原因。新建弹窗按这个开关隐藏字段，要等第二个改动。
- 为什么做：这是「内部新建和编辑表单作废」这张卡的前一半，先把字段上的开关定下来，后一半让新建弹窗、整页新建和动作弹出的新建窗口都按字段分组排，并读这个开关。
- 出错会怎样：最坏情况是某个应用包给必填字段关了这个开关，安装或保存时被拒绝，提示里写了两种改法；现有的定义里没有这个开关，不受影响，撤回本次合并即可。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

`FieldSchema` (`packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`) gains **`showOnCreate`**, an optional boolean.

- **Meaning.** Absent or `true`: the field is asked for when a record is created, as today. `false`: every create surface (the create dialog, the full-page create, an action-opened create) leaves the field out; editing, the record page and lists still show it. The key has no default, so no field parsed today changes shape.
- **Name and admission (ADR-0085 §2).** Per the seat's reading on the claim: the key is a field's creation-time intent (which fields this business asks for when a record is born), not inferable from the schema, and it binds every create surface rather than one page, so its name names no page or dialog. The ADR note rides the week's ADR card after this lands; `docs/adr/**` is untouched here.
- **The one refused pair.** `showOnCreate: false` on a `required: true` field is refused in `FieldSchema`'s `superRefine`, at the field's `showOnCreate` key, so every door that parses a field refuses it (`defineStack`, `os validate`, the metadata save; the object door locates it at `fields.NAME.showOnCreate`). The reason it gives is the card's item 6, which makes no exception: a required field is always asked for when a record is created, so the person creating it sees every value the record must have. The message names both fixes (keep the field on create, or drop `required`). A `defaultValue` makes no exception either (the seat's ruling, card comment 7079131071 item 3): the insert would resolve the default, so such a create could pass, but the field is still asked for, with its default filled in. A `requiredWhen` field is accepted: its gate is a predicate the parse cannot judge, and the write door still refuses a create born inside it.
- **Liveness ledger.** `liveness/field.json` gains a `showOnCreate` row, `planned`, evidence the parse-time refusal. Its readers are PR 2's create surfaces, and the row flips to `live` in that PR, citing them.
- **Generated.** `authorable-surface/data.json` (`data/Field:showOnCreate`), `liveness/state-counts/field.md`, and the three reference pages that render `FieldSchema` (`data/field.mdx`, `data/object.mdx`, `system/migration.mdx`), from `check:generated --fix`.
- **Changeset.** `@objectstack/spec` minor; `@objectstack/driver-sql` and `@objectstack/metadata-core` patch, since their every-field-key ledgers (`FIELD_KEY_STORAGE_CLASS`, `FIELD_REFERENCE_POSITIONS`) now classify the key.

### What this PR deliberately leaves to PR 2

The claim's lines (`Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: semantic`) describe the whole card. Their narrowing and semantic halves belong to PR 2, where an internal form stops steering the create and edit forms; the seat amends the claim when PR 2 opens. Two items move there by the seat's ruling on this split, and the skills text goes to its own card:

- the lint notice for a still-declared internal form (card item 8): its sentence says the form is no longer loaded, which is false until PR 2 retires the readers;
- the Studio switch (card item 7: the `field.form.ts` row, the eleven metadata-forms locale packs, the field inspector): a switch offered before any create surface honours it is the shape ADR-0078 rules out;
- the skills text (card item 9) is #36455 (domain:skills: skills text lands only in a domain:skills PR), hence `Skills-docs: follow-up #36455`.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/data/field-show-on-create.test.ts` (new): the key parses switched on and off and stays absent when not authored; `showOnCreate: false` beside `required: true` is a full `safeParse` failure located at `showOnCreate` with a `custom` issue whose message opens with its first sentence; the same with a `defaultValue`; the object door locates it at `fields.amount.showOnCreate`; four controls are full `safeParse` successes (on + required, required alone, off + not required, off + `requiredWhen`).
- Review round at `1c0012aa`: the refusal's comment, message, describe and the changeset now give the card's reason instead of saying no create could pass (L2 S1); the skills follow-up names #36455 (L1-d). The new test's message assertion follows the reworded first sentence; that file and the reconciliation file ran green at `1c0012aa` (`Tests 81 passed`); `check:generated` 14 of 14 up to date after regenerating the three reference pages; `check:liveness`, `check-changeset-no-major` and `check-nul-bytes` exit 0. The rest of the derived set ran at `197434e9`; this round changed only prose, a test regex and regenerated references.
- CI round at `b86db2be`: Test Core at `1c0012aa` was red in three shards, all field-key pins this key owes: `metadata-protocol` `protocol.meta-types-degenerate-derivation.test.ts` (`field` serves 85 top-level properties, was 84), `driver-sql` `builtin-column-collision.test.ts` ("classifies EVERY FieldSchema key": `showOnCreate` is `presentation`, the DDL never reads it) and `metadata-core` `object-schema-fls-references.test.ts` ("classifies every FieldSchema key": `showOnCreate: keep`, a boolean facet that names no field). Each of the three files ran green locally at `b86db2be` (18, 11 and 63 tests).
- L1-d round at `d8b82f70`: the changeset adds those two patch entries; `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset` and `check-changeset-fixed` exit 0 against `origin/main`. No code changed since `b86db2be`, where all 74 checks finished green (62 success, 12 skipped).
- Reverse verification (one-off, committed fix first, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`): replacing the refusal's condition with `false` turned exactly the three refusal cases red and left the controls green; the file was restored to its HEAD blob (`aebcfbd38223`, `git diff HEAD` empty).

- Package suite at the head before the last commit: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` (local project, under the verify lock) → `Test Files 1 failed | 871 passed (872)`, `Tests 1 failed | 27913 passed | 1 todo`. The one red was `metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts` ("field: every top-level key the author may write is offered, or its omission is recorded" named `showOnCreate`). The last commit records the key as not yet offered (an `omit` row whose reason is the `planned` grade; PR 2 deletes the row and offers the switch); that file and the new test then ran green at `197434e9`: `Test Files 2 passed`, `Tests 81 passed`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` → exit 0. `scripts/liveness/` (repo project) → `Test Files 2 passed`, `Tests 87 passed`.
- `test:repo` beyond `scripts/liveness/` is left to CI's Test Core: the diff touches no repo-project test.

## Acceptance notes

- Overlap at push (`d8b82f70`, unchanged from `b86db2be`): `overlap-check.mjs` reports clean merges with `origin/main` and #36435, #36411, #36386, #36351. #36392 conflicts only in the generated `liveness/state-counts/field.md`; #36399, which also adds a field key, conflicts there and in the `field` property-count pin, which whichever lands second raises by one and regenerates.
- The card's acceptance lines are UI readings (the create dialog, the full-page create, the action modal, the Studio switch). They are PR 2's, with live checks and screenshots there; this PR has no rendered surface.

## Verification

<details><summary>Derived gate families at 197434e9: 115 derived, 114 run green, 1 NOT MEASURED</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` derived 115 commands; each ran with its exit code recorded before any pipe, and `--ran` reconciled: "115 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 114 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED".
- Seven families first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: a `packages/spec/dist` the loop's own siblings had rebuilt without declarations, and the shallow clone missing the teardown fixture commit). After `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` and fetching the fixture commit, all seven re-ran at exit 0: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`, `check:api-surface`, `check:dual-source-exports`, `check:entry-nameability`, `check:exported-any`, `check:generated` (it had reported `api-surface/` stale against that same dist; 14 of 14 up to date after the rebuild), `check:skill-examples`.
- NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 3, prerequisite not met in this container), left to CI.
- `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs` → exit 0.

</details>

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/data/field-show-on-create.test.ts` → 5 passed.

First files to read: `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts` (the `showOnCreate` key beside `hidden`, and the new `superRefine` block before `referenceVia`), `packages/spec/liveness/field.json` (the `planned` row).
